english.note: Use 話 as the all-purpose spoken verb for conveying information or saying something, including 話畀人知 for informing someone.

examples.english: I’ll tell you that we don’t have to work tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我話畀你知，聽日唔使返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for stating or saying an observation.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose way to report that someone claims something, especially when the context makes clear it is unproven.
Use 話 for a plain spoken remark or statement; it is the all-purpose everyday choice when comment simply means say or remark.
Use 話 when reporting what someone says or introducing a rumour or commonly repeated statement.

examples.english: I want to remark that today's wind is really strong.
examples.traditional: 我想話，今日啲風真係大。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 waa6 gam1 jat6 di1 fung1 zan1 hai6 daai6

examples.english: They allege that the shop sells counterfeit goods, but we still need evidence.
examples.traditional: 佢話間舖頭賣假貨，我哋仲要搵證據先。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 gaa2 fo3 ngo5 dei6 zung6 jiu3 wan2 zing3 geoi3 sin1

examples.english: I just want to comment that this arrangement is really convenient.
examples.traditional: 我只係想話，呢個安排真係幾方便。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 waa6 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 zan1 hai6 gei2 fong1 bin6

examples.english: People say the shop will close next month.
examples.traditional: 聽人話間舖下個月結業。
examples.jyutping: ting1 jan4 waa6 gaan1 pou3 haa6 go3 jyut6 git3 jip6
